lead.headline: Drake Maye goes Out in Munich
lead.dek: Maye I touch your TDs? lost its namesake to an ankle injury with 3.02 points on the board. Amon-Ra St. Brown already has 25.8. Against Bad things man bad things, it’s 48.2% to 51.8%, and the quarterback slot is locked.
lead.pull: Maye I touch your TDs? 28.82. Bad things man bad things 0.0. And the scoreboard is the only thing Maye is winning.
body: The franchise I cover named itself after one player, and at 8:48 AM that player is listed Out with an ankle injury. Drake Maye has 3.02 points in Munich. He projected for 23.29. Maye’s game kicked off at 6:30 AM, so the quarterback slot is locked. No swap, no waiver Hail Mary, no lever. The front office that found Emmett Johnson at 7:56 AM Saturday has nothing to click this morning.

Here’s the strange part: Maye I touch your TDs? is winning. 28.82 to 0.0, because Amon-Ra St. Brown has turned the Munich game into his own highlight reel, 25.8 points against a 19.52 projection. The A.J. Brown insurance policy on the bench (14.38) never got cashed, and right now St. Brown is the reason this team still has a pulse.

The live board says coin flip with a lean: Maye 165.12, Bad things 166.94, 48.2% to 51.8%. This morning’s 1.3-point game is now a 1.82-point game going the other way, and that projection still carries some of Maye’s own remaining points. Read it as optimistic.

Bad things man bad things hasn’t played a snap. All 11 starters are still to come, led by Bijan Robinson (20.42), Chuba Hubbard (18.84) and James Cook III (17.73), with C.J. Stroud (17.96) and Tyler Shough (17.43) under center. It doesn’t need to be clever. It needs to be average.

Maye’s path runs through Brock Purdy (22.5), now the only quarterback on the roster with a full day ahead, plus Johnson (16.44) in the 10:00 AM window and Zay Flowers (16.24) on Monday at 5:15 PM. Nine Maye starters left. Every one of them just got a bigger job.

I picked Maye against the model at 5:43 AM. I’m flipping it. A 2-7 team running one healthy quarterback against a 7-2 team with its whole lineup intact is a 51.8% favorite that feels like more. Bad things, narrowly. Prove me wrong, Purdy.

George Kittle (15.27) can still slide in by 1:25 PM. The game is 0.4%, but AB81 has the fewest points of the three 7-2 teams, 1353.58, and the tiebreaker counts every one.

quick_hits.body: By 8:48 AM one NFL game was final and one was live, and the live one belongs to R.A.T.S.: Gibbs (32.8), St. Brown (25.8), Goff (21.14), Jameson Williams (4.7), Maye (3.02), Sam LaPorta (2.5), Stevenson (1.4). Twelve more games to go.
